name: session: close the browser mid-analysis, come back and carry on
description: Exp-G from the decision log, and the test of the claim that research state is durable Galaxy state while conversation state is transient. Two turns start an analysis and submit work; `restartAfter` then drops the conversation entirely, modelling someone closing the browser and returning with nothing stored -- a different machine, cleared storage, a session that never persisted. The remaining turns run from the system context alone, so anything the agent recovers has to come from the Notebook and from Galaxy. The jobs keep running server-side regardless, which is the half a browser-delivered agent gets for free and a local shell does not.
